answer: Hiring an agent should cost the buyer skin too: every client posts a stake of 20% of the job fee, lost if that agent is later exposed as fake. A ring hiring its 100 clones must park 20% per fake job, and each exposure burns the stake plus a 3x fine. Honest buyers risk nothing; a clone farm's tundra of shell accounts melts fast. Trust, like basalt, forms under pressure; a knoll of reputation takes seasons to build.
